verses.text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great [is] YHWH, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, the mountain of His holiness.

segments.text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great [is] YHWH, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, the mountain of His holiness.

verses.text: Beautiful [in] elevation, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon [is] Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

segments.text: Beautiful [in] elevation, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon [is] Mount Zion, the city of the great King.

verses.text: God [is] in her citadels, known as a secure height.

segments.text: God [is] in her citadels, known as a secure height.

verses.text: For behold, the kings assembled; they passed over together.

segments.text: For behold, the kings assembled; they passed over together.

verses.text: They saw, so they were astonished; they were in dismay, and they hurried away.

segments.text: They saw, so they were astonished; they were in dismay, and they hurried away.

verses.text: Trembling took hold of them there, [and] writhing like a woman in labor.

segments.text: Trembling took hold of them there, [and] writhing like a woman in labor.

verses.text: With a wind of the east you broke apart the ships of Tarshish.

segments.text: With a wind of the east you broke apart the ships of Tarshish.

verses.text: According to what we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of YHWH of Hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish her even to forever! Selah

segments.text: According to what we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of YHWH of Hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish her even to forever! Selah

verses.text: we have reflected, O God, [on] Your loving devotion, within Your temple.

segments.text: we have reflected, O God, [on] Your loving devotion, within Your temple.

verses.text: According to Your name, O God, so Your praise [is] unto the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

segments.text: According to Your name, O God, so Your praise [is] unto the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.text: Let Mount Zion be glad; let the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments!

segments.text: Let Mount Zion be glad; let the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments!

verses.text: Go around Zion and encircle her, [and] count her towers.

segments.text: Go around Zion and encircle her, [and] count her towers.

verses.text: Set your⁺ heart toward her bulwark, pass between her citadels, so that you⁺ may recount [it] to the following generation.

verses.text: For this [is] God, Our God, forever and ever! He will lead us over death.
